consequence.statement: Users without explicit `logs, get` RBAC permissions will lose access to the logs tab in pod view, even if they have `applications, get` access. Previously implicit logs access through `applications, get` is no longer granted.
consequence.remediation: Grant explicit `logs, get` RBAC permissions to users, groups, or roles that require access to logs. After upgrade, remove the `server.rbac.log.enforce.enable` setting from the `argocd-cm` ConfigMap if present.

assertion.statement: Starting from Argo CD 3.0, logs RBAC enforcement is enabled by default; the `server.rbac.log.enforce.enable` flag is removed from `argocd-cm` ConfigMap and users no longer automatically get logs access through `applications, get` permissions alone.
